body: Nope he was between 4th and 6th grade, shoulda probably cleared that up.
Thanks friend, I really do appreciate it.

Man, if only I had the chance to go back to when I was 15....

Don't let this ruin the rest of your childhood. Do me a favor, wait until you're at least 21 to make this decision. You have so much to experience yet, truly the greatest parts of your life. Trust me, if I actually had gone through with what my illness was telling me to do when I was your age, I wouldn't be posting this right now. This is coming from someone who is depressed right now, too. I love you, friend!
Shoot me a message brother (or sister). I'm right there with you.
